title: pkg/storage/ scope and subdirectory map
answers: Is pkg/storage the general SQL layer?
What do the subdirectories under pkg/storage/unified/ do?
body: pkg/storage/ is the persistence layer for Grafana's k8s-style resource API (unified storage): implements k8s.io/apiserver/pkg/storage.Interface plus a gRPC ResourceServer/SearchServer so pkg/services/apiserver can serve resource kinds (dashboards, folders, playlists, secrets) via common CRUD/watch/search. It is NOT the legacy SQL layer for older services (that's pkg/services/sqlstore / pkg/infra/db). unified/ holds 470 of ~516 files. Subdirs: unified/resource (core server, StorageBackend, blob/GC/quota, watch), unified/sql (legacy SQL backend + gRPC bootstrap, being retired), unified/search (bleve index + authz post-filtering), unified/apistore (bridges k8s storage.Interface to gRPC client), unified/migrations (legacy to unified SQL migration), unified/proto and resourcepb (shared gRPC contract), unified/semgrep (custom lint for compatibility), unified/testing (shared backend test harness), legacysql/dualwrite (dual-write orchestration), secret/ (SQL storage for secrets).
